question: Should memory-core permanently expose the new skipped-recall reason and discard previously persisted placeholder candidates during normalization?
rationale: The mechanics are testable, but the exported Plugin SDK contract and upgrade treatment of existing recall state require explicit owner intent.

options.title: Accept reason and cleanup
options.body: Approve the additive event reason and removal of placeholder-only persisted candidates, then require exact-head real-workspace proof before merge.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Retain the runtime filtering but remove the new exported event reason to avoid expanding the Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Preserve existing entries
options.body: Filter newly recorded and rehydrated candidates while deferring cleanup of persisted entries until an explicit migration policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept reason and cleanup
recommendation.body: Approve the additive event reason and removal of placeholder-only persisted candidates, then require exact-head real-workspace proof before merge.
